candidates.change_summary: Return bytes4(0) instead of the onERC721Received selector so callers observe a different return value.
Return a different selector value (0x150b7a01) instead of the correct onERC721Received selector.
Assign the NFT address to baseToken instead of the base token parameter.
Delete the assignment so baseToken is never set and remains address(0).
Assign the zero address to baseToken instead of the base token parameter.
Replace the assignment `nft = _nft;` with `nft = _baseToken;` so the pool's nft state becomes the base token address.
Delete the statement `nft = _nft;` so `nft` remains address(0) after initialization.
Replace the assignment `nft = _nft;` with `nft = msg.sender;` so the nft state becomes the caller's address.
Delete the statement that assigns _changeFee to changeFee, so changeFee remains 0 after initialize.
Replace the changeFee assignment with an assignment of a fixed value 1, so changeFee is 1 regardless of the passed argument.
Replace the changeFee assignment with an assignment of _feeRate, so changeFee gets the feeRate value instead of the changeFee argument.
Replace the changeFee assignment with an increment of _changeFee by one, so changeFee stores _changeFee + 1.
Replace the feeRate assignment with a hardcoded zero so initialize never stores the caller-supplied fee rate.
Store _feeRate incremented by one so the resulting feeRate always differs from the original by 1.
Delete the assignment of feeRate so the variable is never set during initialize.
Relax the fee rate bound from 5_000 to 5_001 so a _feeRate of 5_001 is stored instead of reverting.
Move the feeRate assignment above the AlreadyInitialized check so a second initialize call overwrites feeRate instead of reverting.
